title: In 2010, Nebraska couple financed $100,000 building sale; buyer defaulted in 2012, court upheld $247,068 foreclosure
summary_full: In a significant legal decision, the Nebraska Supreme Court ruled on a foreclosure case involving RCTS Properties, which failed to fulfill payments on a seller-financed loan. The court clarified that the timeline for foreclosure wasn't impacted by bankruptcy filings or claims. It emphasized a 10-year limit for such actions, rejecting the buyer's assertions and allowing the property's sale if the outstanding amount stayed unpaid.
